correctness.rationale: Direct exterior-algebra proof bounds length by six and a fixed four-ground-label construction attains it. The exact witness-cover equivalence is proved for n>=5. Two exhaustive independently represented six-edge pattern enumerators give identical support coefficients and prove no pattern uses ten or more labels. One uses 2^q weighting for first-introduction pairs and the other 2^6 weighting for fully oriented endpoint positions. Direct Kneser adjacency enumeration for n=5..8 matches all corresponding counts. Replayed packaged scripts, no interpolation.

value.rationale: For a canonical infinite sequence-extremization problem previously solved only at the maximum-length level, the theorem gives the exact labelled count of all optimal ordered procedures, six support strata, the unexpected nine-element support ceiling, and asymptotic random success probability 32/n^3. The additional terms are not the known four-label construction or a routine numeric substitution; they require a complete finite pattern classification and are reproducible.
